hero_sub: Welcome to Athithi Homestay — relax to cool sea breezes, savour home-cooked Kerala meals and experience warm hospitality in the serene beauty of North Kerala.

about_paragraphs.text: Nestled in Ezhome on the North Kerala coast, Athithi Homestay is your perfect base to unwind. Set amidst a beautiful garden and lawn, our home offers the ideal mix of comfort, scenic views and genuine local charm for an unforgettable stay.

Our homestay features 2 fully air-conditioned bedrooms and 1 comfortable non-A/C room — perfect for families and groups. Relax in the spacious hall, enjoy home-cooked meals in the dining area, and make use of the fully equipped kitchen. Two balconies with scenic views, attached bathrooms and round-the-clock hot water complete the comfort.

Known as the "Land of Looms and Lores", Kannur welcomes you with pristine beaches, vibrant Theyyam rituals, historic forts and misty hill trails — and we're perfectly placed for nature lovers to enjoy it all.

rooms.title: A/C Bedrooms
rooms.desc: Two air-conditioned bedrooms with comfortable beds, attached bathrooms and all the essentials for a relaxed stay.

rooms.title: Non-A/C Room
rooms.desc: A comfortable, budget-friendly room with natural ventilation — keeping all the comfort and the same warm Athithi hospitality.

rooms.title: Living, Dining & Kitchen
rooms.desc: Relax in the spacious hall with TV, enjoy meals in the dining area and make use of the fully equipped kitchen.

attractions.title: Muzhappilangad Drive-in Beach
attractions.desc: Asia's longest drive-in beach — drive on the sand, catch sunrises and go fishing along the serene shoreline.

attractions.title: St. Angelo Fort (Kannur Fort)
attractions.desc: A historic triangular Portuguese-built seaside fort offering panoramic views of the Arabian Sea and the town.

attractions.title: Paithal Mala
attractions.desc: A scenic trekking hotspot with dense forests, rich wildlife and stunning hill views on the Kerala–Karnataka border.

attractions.title: Palakkayam Thattu
attractions.desc: A misty hill station offering trekking, camping and sweeping panoramas of the Western Ghats.

attractions.title: Payyambalam Beach
attractions.desc: A popular Kannur beach with golden sands, coconut groves and gorgeous sunset views over the Arabian Sea.

attractions.title: Kavvayi Backwaters & Kayaking
attractions.desc: Kerala's third-largest backwater — glide through serene waters with kayaking and boat savari for nature lovers.

attractions.title: Ezhimala Beach & Hills
attractions.desc: The sea curves around three sides of the seven-peaked Ezhimala hills — a striking coastal landscape rich in legend.

attractions.title: Parassinikadavu Muthappan Temple
attractions.desc: A famous temple dedicated to Muthappan, renowned for its daily Theyyam performances and calm setting.

attractions.title: Arakkal Museum
attractions.desc: The heritage home of Kerala's only Muslim royal family, showcasing artefacts of the Arakkal dynasty.

attractions.title: Thalassery Fort
attractions.desc: One of Kerala's most important former European trading centres — an atmospheric laterite fort with sea views.

attractions.title: Bekal Fort
attractions.desc: Kerala's largest and best-kept fort, set dramatically on a headland with sweeping Arabian Sea views.

attractions.title: Ananthapura Lake Temple
attractions.desc: The only lake temple in Kerala — a picturesque shrine set in the middle of a serene lake.
